hebrewText: וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָהַ֤ב אֶת יוֹסֵף֙ מִ/כָּל בָּנָ֔י/ו כִּֽי בֶן זְקֻנִ֥ים ה֖וּא ל֑/וֹ וְ/עָ֥שָׂה ל֖/וֹ כְּתֹ֥נֶת פַּסִּֽים

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
